clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around Teodor's death in January 1978, within the following months: Delphine stopped cooking and went to her mother's every evening, Duncan took night shifts and distanced from Odette, Anton drank at lunch with a warning at work, then separated from Celeste in August, Odette lay awake over her mother and Anton, and Callum had ear infections through the winter. The shifts pile up across the extended family around the same time, each one near another's.

clusters.name: Odette's bed rest, 1984
clusters.reason: Around Odette ordered to bed in March 1984: Hazel came every morning to keep the house, Duncan argued with his mother over how she kept it, Callum stammered again, and you could not sleep unless your father sat by the bed. The shifts fall within these months around the change in Odette's functioning, with no one else's shifts shown in those months.

clusters.name: Callum's move north, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around Callum leaving home for a job up north in May 1999: Duncan and Callum argued most nights over the plans, Odette could not settle at the thought of him so far away, Duncan missed days at work and sat up late in the garage, Ines skipped school through the autumn, and Odette took Ines with her everywhere. clusters.name: Hazel's death, 2003
clusters.reason: Around Hazel's death in January 2003: you could not sleep more than a few hours a night, stopped going to the bookshop and lost your job, dreaded buses and crowded shops and went out only after dark, and then took a job at the garden centre and slept through the night again. All shifts in these months are yours, and no one else's shows then.
